title: RE: Aurora 3.2 – status inputs for Monday report

definitions.meaning: Code merged to main with all unit tests passing.

context_note: Reply to the PMO's weekly request for status inputs. Earlier messages in the thread are routine reminders.
content:
Hi, inputs for the report below.

Development: all 3.2 stories are done and merged, so you can mark dev complete as confirmed.

Billing API v2 integration: confirmed. PR #482 (billing client rewrite for API v2) was merged to main on Friday, all unit tests green. The contract tests against the Meridian sandbox will run in staging as part of the nightly pipeline on Monday night, so we should have that by Tuesday morning.

Performance: perf test environment is booked Monday evening, will share numbers later in the week.

Nothing blocking from our side. Cheers.
